title: Original-business communication adoption, recovery support and long-term compatibility
statement: The channel is now exercised through the real runner service, the real ProductStore ingress, a real-store Broker-equivalent guard, and real authenticated endpoints (dual client, succession, ACK windows, backpressure, four slots, shutdown, interface compatibility). Module scope only: original Work recovery, candidate/manualaccept/slot release, native/vendor and installed facts remain outside this evidence.

outcomes.title: Actual main/B source closure adopted
outcomes.implementation: shared module/pull adapter already adopted at main 303b2c6a and B 4b693eae
outcomes.positive: original fact id on the wire, fresh intent correlation, one write after admission
outcomes.negative: retired allowed replay, foreign fact, duplicate bootstrap

outcomes.title: Original Store sink adoption
outcomes.implementation: sink bound to real ProductStore ingress
outcomes.positive: receipt read back from original fact table with matching seq and payload digest
outcomes.negative: foreign producer and missing payload refused with no row

outcomes.title: Original Broker-style admission per intent
outcomes.implementation: guard reads real current binding + recorded command digest + one-shot admission
outcomes.negative: missing/deny/throw/mismatched body/stale binding/reused admission => zero writes

outcomes.title: Same Work normal + dual client
outcomes.positive: B takes over by CAS mid-attempt and continues the same fact ids
outcomes.negative: old A poll/reply fenced, foreign producer refused, no stdio mirroring

outcomes.title: Lease succession and remaining window
outcomes.positive: same original fact id retried with reported window not refreshed
outcomes.negative: replaced client poll/reply refused; stale/future generation refused

outcomes.title: ACK window and reply correlation
outcomes.positive: first exact ACK settles; original pending stays until its own id
outcomes.negative: duplicate, wrong kind, wrong id and post-close replies refused

outcomes.title: Backpressure and control availability
outcomes.implementation: constructor bounds in the active implementation
outcomes.positive: 64 queued facts serve and capacity recovers for a later record
outcomes.negative: 65th concurrent fact refused with capacity, not a hang or success
outcomes.evidence: 1 case; verified against the real service's DEFAULT_LIMITS

outcomes.title: Recovery-chain communication support
outcomes.positive: one fact, one fresh intent, termination; single guard call
outcomes.negative: remote denial leaves zero writes; late admission refused
outcomes.notReached: recovered original A process / native_applied / ACK-unknown / candidate / manualaccept / slot release (B/main)

outcomes.title: Two- and four-slot isolation
outcomes.positive: each slot serves only its own fact and keeps generation 2
outcomes.negative: denial/drain in one slot does not touch others
outcomes.notReached: product scheduler aggregate slot release (B/main); this probe is communication-only

outcomes.title: Fault and shutdown terminal states
outcomes.implementation: module terminal semantics + real service shutdown
outcomes.positive: idle shutdown terminates; malformed frame refused without owner change
outcomes.negative: pending fact stays unknown (no fabricated receipt); no silent success
outcomes.reportedGap: B's closeAdmission drops only fixed stdio/sink ids, so a remote lease remains current after shutdown and a late reply can still settle; B should use attach.close() on terminal shutdown

outcomes.title: Public interface and historical-call compatibility
outcomes.negative: v2 frame and missing-id envelope refused with protocol_error

outcomes.title: Reproducible adoption manual and handoff
outcomes.positive: closure, call graph, authorities, runnable commands
outcomes.negative: layer table prevents module green from being read as product recovery
